blocks.text: A busy calendar of inflation data, central-bank speeches and late-season earnings. The common thread: whether services inflation is cooling fast enough to justify the rate cuts markets still hope for.

items: **Central-bank speakers**: any change in language on the balance of risks.
**AI regulation**: consultations on model-risk management in financial services.
**Earnings**: retailers and the remaining large technology firms.

blocks.text: Markets have priced a slower path for rate cuts. Data that confirms that view should be absorbed calmly; a surprise in either direction could move longer-dated yields more than equities.
